text:
sasha: Heads up — monitoring shows heartbeat_missing spike from gpu-probe in us-west-2-rack11 -> rack14 since ~20m ago. Capacity dropped ~8% and autoscaler is not backfilling. Seeing elevated Xid 13/46 logs on some cards.

raj: Got it, oncall jumping in. Any affected ML jobs we should preemptively drain?

infra-bot: [ALERT] metric=heartbeat_missing host_group=us-west-2-rack11..rack14 count=24 window=15m severity=high

sasha: Yes, a couple of high-priority prod routes hit 503s briefly. Also noticing small memory-correctable errors in kernel logs. Not full ECC storm but correlated.

maria: Can you paste last 50 lines of dmesg from one affected machine? Also kernel/driver version?

sasha: Paste snippet:

```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 31, pid=14321, ...
[ 12345.679002] nvidia: GPU 0: corrected ECC error
[ 12346.000123] gpu-probe: heartbeat timeout for GPU 0
```

Driver: 535.113, kube-node-probe v1.2.1

raj: From infra side I'll mark the node pool for proactive cordon, move pods off rack11 first. Ben, can you estimate provisioning impact if we cordon 4 racks (~150 GPUs)?

ben: If cordon all 4 racks we'll lose ~12% capacity. Autoscaler will kick but warmup is ~20-30m for spare instances. Cost hit estimate for immediate replacement via burst instances ~ +$12k/day if sustained.

kai: Suggest running targeted reboot of the node-level nvlink firmware sequence first — we've seen transient heartbeat timeouts cleared by that. Should we try rolling reboots on one rack to confirm?

maria: Agree. Also let's snapshot kernel logs and enable verbose probe logging: set `GPU_PROBE_VERBOSE=1` on those nodes.

sasha: Proceeding with controlled rack reboot (rack11) now. I'll tag the rollout and monitor heartbeat metric. Rolling window 1 rack -> wait 10m -> continue.

infra-bot: [ACTION] cordon: node=usw2-rack11-node03 by=raj

raj: pods draining on rack11. Progress 60%.

sasha: After rack11 reboot heartbeats returned for most GPUs, Xid drops to baseline. Still 2 nodes showing intermittent misses, keeping them cordoned for further inspection.

ben: Good outcome. If the reboot clears the rest we can avoid provisioning. Keep me posted before we uncordon.

maria: I'll collect nvlink/fabric logs and open a ticket for driver team to investigate potential firmware regression.

sasha: Thanks team :thumbsup:. Postmortem notes: follow up to add a quick-hit runbook for heartbeat flaps and an autoscaler warmup doc.

kai: Also flagging this pattern for the monitoring team to add an automated playbook trigger.

sasha: End of thread — will update if anything new.
